description: Read the text messages received on your MeiSIM numbers, newest first. Filter to one number and/or to messages after a timestamp. To follow a conversation, pass the received_at of the last message you saw as since. Needs your API key.

number.description: One of your numbers, e.g. "4234322309" or "+1 423 432 2309". Omit for all numbers.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only messages received after it.

name: read_messages
title: Read received texts
